newsitem.title: UK: Siemens to sell defence unit -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Siemens to sell defence unit -- paper.

text.p: German electrical and electronics group Siemens AG has abandoned plans to place its defence electronics business in a joint venture in favour of a trade sale, a report in the Financial Times said on Tuesday.
The FT said the company had hired investment bank Morgan Stanley to draw up a shortlist of possible bidders and hoped to complete the sale by its September year end.
The paper said the sale was being led at Morgan Stanley by Sir Peter Levene, Britain's former chief of defence procurement.
It said Levene expected to issue an information memorandum on the sale shortly.
Last month Siemens had said it was talking to several possible partners for the unit.
